arabic_title: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى اتباع الرسل و مُصَدِّقِيهم
english_title: 4. Blessings on Followers & Attestors to Prophets

phrases.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَتْبَاعُ الرُّسُلِ وَمُصَدِّقُوهُمْ
phrases.english: 1.O God, as for the followers of the messengers and those of the people

phrases.arabic: مِنْ أَهْلِ الاَرْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ عِنْدَ مُعَارَضَةِ الْمُعَـانِدينَ لَهُمْ
phrases.english: 2.of the earth who attested to them unseen (while the obstinate resisted them

phrases.arabic: بِالتَّكْذِيبِ وَالاشْتِيَاقِ إلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ بِحَقائِقِ الايْمَانِ .
phrases.english: 3.through crying lies) - they yearned for the emissaries through the realities of faith

phrases.arabic: فِي كُلِّ دَهْر وَزَمَان أَرْسَلْتَ فِيْهِ رَسُولاً، وَأَقَمْتَ لاهْلِهِ دَلِيلاً،
phrases.english: 4.in every era and time in which You didst send a messenger and set up for the people a director

phrases.arabic: مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إلَى مُحَمَّد صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ مِنْ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُـدَى،
phrases.english: 5.from the period of Adam down to Muhammad (God bless him and his Household) from among the imams of guidance

phrases.arabic: وَقَادَةِ أَهْـلِ التُّقَى عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمُ السَّلاَمُ،
phrases.english: 6.and the leaders of the godfearing (upon them all be peace) -

phrases.arabic: فَاذْكُرْهُمْ مِنْكَ بِمَغْفِرَة وَرِضْوَان.
phrases.english: 7.remember them with forgiveness and good pleasure!

phrases.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّد خَاصَّةً الَّـذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الصَّحَابَةَ،
phrases.english: 8.O God, and as for the Companions of Muhammad specifically, those who did well in companionship,

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ أَبْلَوْا الْبَلاَءَ الْحَسَنَ فِي نَصْرِهِ،
phrases.english: 9.who stood the good test in helping him,

phrases.arabic: وَكَانَفُوهُ وَأَسْرَعُوا إلَى وِفَادَتِهِ وَسَابَقُوا إلَى دَعْوَتِهِ
phrases.english: 10. supported his mission, promptly advanced at his call, answered it as soon as he made them

phrases.arabic: واسْتَجَابُوا لَهُ حَيْثُ أَسْمَعَهُمْ حجَّةَ رِسَالاَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 11.responded to him when he made them hear his messages' argument,

phrases.arabic: وَفَارَقُوا الازْوَاجَ وَالاوْلادَ فِي إظْهَارِ كَلِمَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 12.separated from mates and children in manifesting his word,

phrases.arabic: وَقَاتَلُوا الاباءَ وَ الابناءَ فِي تَثْبِيتِ نبُوَّتِهِ،
phrases.english: 13.fought against fathers and sons in strengthening his prophecy,

phrases.arabic: وَانْتَصَرُوا بهِ وَمَنْ كَانُوا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى
phrases.english: 14.and through him gained victory; those who were wrapped in

phrases.arabic: مَحبَّتِهِ يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِي مَوَدَّتِهِ،
phrases.english: 15.affection for him, "hoping for a commerce that comes not to naught" (35:29) in love for him;

phrases.arabic: وَالّذينَ هَجَرَتْهُمُ العَشَائِرُ إذْ تَعَلَّقُوا بِعُرْوَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 16.those who were left by their clans when they clung to his handhold

phrases.arabic: وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَاباتُ إذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
phrases.english: 17.and denied by their kinsfolk when they rested in the shadow of his kinship;

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَفِيكَ،
phrases.english: 18.forget not, O God, what they abandoned for You and in You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 19.and make them pleased with Your good pleasure for the sake of the creatures they drove to You

phrases.arabic: وَكَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 20.while they were with Your Messenger, summoners to You for You.

phrases.arabic: وَاشكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيْكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 21.Show gratitude to them for leaving the abodes of their people for Your sake

phrases.arabic: وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إلَى ضِيْقِهِ،
phrases.english: 22.and going out from a plentiful livelihood to a narrow one,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إعْزَازِ دِيْنِـكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ.
phrases.english: 23.and [show gratitude to] those of them who became objects of wrongdoing and whom You multiplied in exalting Your religion.

phrases.arabic: ألّهُمَّ وَأوْصِلْ إلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإحْسَان الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ :
phrases.english: 24.O God, and give to those who have done well in following the Companions, who say,

phrases.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلاخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالاِيمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ،
phrases.english: 25."Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who went before us in faith" (59:10), Your best reward;

phrases.arabic: الَّذِينَ قَصَدُوا سَمْتَهُمْ، وَتَحَرَّوْا وِجْهَتَهُمْ، وَمَضَوْا عَلى شاكِلَتِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 26.those who went straight to the Companions' road, sought out their course, and proceeded in their manner.

phrases.arabic: لَمْ يَثْنِهِمْ رَيْبٌ فِي بَصِيْرَتِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ
phrases.english: 27.No doubt concerning their sure insight diverted them and no uncertainty shook them

phrases.arabic: فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ وَالاِئْتِمَامِ بِهِدَايَةِ مَنَارِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 28.from following in their tracks and being led by the guidance of their light.

phrases.arabic: مُكَانِفِينَ وَمُوَازِرِيْنَ لَهُمْ، يَدِيْنُونَ بِدِيْنِهِمْ، وَيَهْتَدُونَ بِهَدْيِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 29.As their assistants and supporters, they professed their religion, gained guidance through their guidance,

phrases.arabic: يَتَّفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلاَ يَتَّهِمُونَهُمْ فِيمَا أدَّوْا إلَيْهِمْ.
phrases.english: 30.came to agreement with them, and never accused them in what they passed on to them.

phrases.arabic: ألَّلهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التّابِعِيْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذا إلى يَوْم الدِّينِ،
phrases.english: 31.O God, and bless the Followers, from this day of ours to the Day of Doom,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى أزْوَاجِهِمْ، وَعَلَى ذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 32.their wives, their offspring,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مِنْهُمْ صَلاْةً تَعْصِمُهُمْ بِهَامِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 33.and those among them who obey You, with a blessing through which You wilt preserve them from disobeying You,

phrases.arabic: وَتَفْسَحُ لَهُمْ فِي رِيَاضِ جَنَّتِكَ، وَتَمْنَعُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ كَيْدِ الشَيْطَانِ،
phrases.english: 34.make room for them in the plots of Your Garden, defend them from the trickery of Satan,

phrases.arabic: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ،
phrases.english: 35.help them in the piety in which they seek help from You,

phrases.arabic: وَتَقِيهِمْ طَوَارِقَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إلاّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْر،
phrases.english: 36.protect them from sudden events that come by night and day - except the events which come with good -

phrases.arabic: وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَـاءِ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 37.and incite them to tie firmly the knot of good hope in You,

phrases.arabic: وَالطَّمَعِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَرْكِ النُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْويهِ
phrases.english: 38.desire what is with You, and refrain from ill thoughts [toward You] because of what

phrases.arabic: أيْدِي الْعِبَادِ لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 39.the hands of Your servants' hold. Thus You mayest restore them to beseeching You and fearing You,

phrases.arabic: وَتُزَهِّدُهُمْ فِي سَعَةِ العَاجِلِ وَتُحَبِّبُ إلَيْهِمُ
phrases.english: 40.induce them to renounce the plenty of the immediate, make them love to

phrases.arabic: الْعَمَلَ لِلاجِلِ، وَالاسْتِعْدَادَ لِمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ
phrases.english: 41.work for the sake of the deferred and prepare for what comes after death, make easy for them

phrases.arabic: كُلَّ كَرْب يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ يَوْمَ خُـرُوجِ الانْفُسِ مِنْ أَبْدَانِهَا
phrases.english: 42.every distress that comes to them on the day when souls take leave from bodies,

phrases.arabic: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ  مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا،
phrases.english: 43.release them from that which brings about the perils of temptation

phrases.arabic: وَكَبَّةِ النَّارِ وَطُولِ الْخُلُودِ فِيهَا،
phrases.english: 44.and being thrown down in the Fire and staying forever within it,

phrases.arabic: وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إلَى أَمْن مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ .
phrases.english: 45.and take them to security, the resting place of the godfearing.
